profile.headline: Staff Android Engineer at Walmart
profile.summary:
Experience with mobile development and web development 

Specialties: Android, Java, PHP

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented new features for Android apps that stream live and vod content
- Debugged and fixed many bugs in Android and Lua language
- Updated applications to support different android OS version starting from 2.3
- Created scripts and tools for making and testing builds
- Worked with different OEMs and carriers on development and troubleshooting
- Minor experience with debugging and fixing issues in iOS
- Worked in an Agile environment

positions.title: Web/IT intern
positions.description: I designed and implemented front-end and back-end web pages using html, php, javascript and CSS. I maintained and designed database tables for Mysql

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: I used Cuda to design and develop a Kuukoo hash in parallel. I contributed to implementing a Geometric hashing algorithm for the Kuukoo hash. Languages and tools used is C, VS2005 and CUDA.
